Package pokemonjavaedition

Class PokeMove

java.lang.Object
pokemonjavaedition.PokeMove
public class PokeMove extends Object
It manages all the info that has a pokemon move in the game.

  • Constructor Details

    • PokeMove

      public PokeMove(String category)
      Creates a pokemove with just his category, used for special pokemove objects like the switch.
      Parameters:
      category - the category of a move. It can be special, physical, status or of a special type, like switch, or empty.

    • PokeMove

      public PokeMove(String name, String type, String category, double power, double accuracy, String statModifier, String statSign)
      Create a complete pokemove, with all his principal stats already set.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the move
      type - the type of the move (fire, water, grass ecc...)
      category - the category of the move (physical, special, status ecc...)
      power - the damage that does a move
      accuracy - the chance that a move have to not miss
      statModifier - the stat that a move can modify. It is empty if no stat is influenced.
      statSign - the stat sign, which can be + or -, if the stat is boosted or nerfed. It is strictly correlated to the statModifier.
